turns.question: Between 1 and 10 October 2026, how many euros less did a first-time buyer's order come to, on average, than a returning customer's?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric that splits average order value between first-time buyers and returning customers, so I cannot give that difference. The closest metrics are Average order value (EUR), which covers all non-cancelled orders with no buyer-type split, and Repeat-customer revenue share and Revenue from repeat customers (EUR), which only measure repeat customers.
